name: OpenKIM
description: Builds the KIM API 2.4.2 (libkim-api, kim-api-collections-management and its example models) into /usr/local with GCC, for interatomic models from the OpenKIM repository. With the materials-python Feature it also builds the hash-pinned kimpy 2.1.4, which the ASE KIM calculator uses. Models are added with kim-api-collections-management install.
